workspace-overview.intent: Understand performance and decide what needs attention across a workspace.
workspace-overview.shell: Workspace sidebar on the left, compact context topbar, main canvas. Reuse the app shell; mobile navigation opens on demand.
regions: Primary trend with supporting breakdown when available
Actionable exceptions or work queue when needed
workspace-overview.layout: Start with a metric row sized to real content and a 2:1 main/supporting region when the relationship warrants it. Put urgent work before analytics for action-first users.
workspace-overview.responsive: Stack by decision priority; retain metric units and period labels; charts get a bounded readable region.
omit: Charts, maps and recent activity that answer no user question
Global search, notifications or workspace switching without product behavior
checks: Metrics match their source and unit
Chart titles and labels explain the comparison
Keyboard navigation and supported theme contrast

management-list.intent: Find, compare and act on operational records repeatedly.
management-list.shell: Workspace sidebar by default for a multi-module app; preserve an existing shell. A single-purpose tool may need only top navigation.
regions: Page title and primary action when available
management-list.layout: Give the table most of the canvas. Frequent filters stay visible; advanced filters can use a panel. Quick detail may open beside the list; substantial editing uses a route.
management-list.responsive: Wrap actions and filters; keep table overflow local and identity/actions discoverable. Use mobile cards only when they preserve the task better than column comparison.
omit: KPI row without a prioritization need
Search, selection or bulk actions without a real contract
Duplicate create actions without a reason
checks: Stable row IDs and selection scope
Filter on a later page and stale request protection

record-detail.intent: Understand one entity and perform contextual actions.
record-detail.shell: Inherit the workspace shell; use a route for deep links or extended work, a sheet for quick list comparison.
regions: History only when supplied and meaningful
record-detail.layout: One column for linear content; 2:1 main/context when the information has distinct roles. Use label-value rows instead of a card per attribute.
record-detail.responsive: Stack main then supporting context; preserve identity and action access without excessive sticky chrome.
omit: Tabs for tiny groups of fields
checks: Long values and missing optional fields
Contextual actions follow permissions and result contracts

editor-form.intent: Create or edit structured data with validation and recoverable submission.
editor-form.shell: Inherit the app shell for long work; a short contextual task may use a panel.
editor-form.layout: One column by default; pair short related fields when width allows. Use sections for long forms; steps only for real stages/dependencies. Constrain form width instead of stretching inputs across a wide canvas.
editor-form.responsive: Stack fields in reading order; keep action bars from covering errors or keyboard focus; scroll long panel bodies.
omit: Stepper based only on field count
Confirmation for harmless edits without product reason
checks: Zero, long text, keyboard and labels

settings.intent: Change durable preferences with clear save scope.
settings.shell: Inherit the app shell; add local settings navigation only for meaningful groups.
regions: Save feedback/actions for the owning scope
Destructive account actions only when required
settings.layout: Readable-width sections or setting rows. A small settings surface stays on one page. Separate save scopes only when their lifecycles are independent.
settings.responsive: Stack label/help/control where needed and keep the save scope obvious.
omit: Unexplained mixing of immediate-save and explicit Save

master-detail.intent: Process a stream of records while retaining list context.
master-detail.shell: Workspace navigation plus list and detail; reduce columns when content no longer fits.
master-detail.layout: Use a stable list pane and a larger detail pane. Keep identity and unread/status context scan-friendly. Independent scroll regions need usable keyboard paths.
master-detail.responsive: Navigate list to detail on narrow screens with an obvious back action; preserve selection/scroll context when returning.
omit: Three columns regardless of available width
Losing the selected record on harmless refresh
checks: Unsaved detail changes on selection switch
No unreachable content in nested scrolling

service-landing.intent: Explain a real offer and help the visitor take the next step.
service-landing.shell: Top navigation, vertically ordered content and footer; no workspace sidebar by default.
service-landing.layout: Use a focused hero. Split text/media only when media adds evidence or identity; vary section rhythm according to content rather than repeating a card grid.
service-landing.responsive: Preserve reading order; scale headings and media without clipping; keep CTA destination clear.
omit: Invented testimonials, client logos or metrics
Decorative interactions that delay the CTA
checks: Every CTA has a real destination or flow
Long copy and image loading reflow

pricing.intent: Compare offers and understand cost and commitment.
pricing.shell: Top navigation for a public site; existing workspace shell for in-app billing.
regions: Purchase/contact action and genuine open questions
pricing.layout: Align comparable information across plans. Highlight a plan only with a product reason; detailed feature comparison can use a table.
pricing.responsive: Stack plans with clear identities and repeated billing context; contain wide comparisons locally.
omit: A billing toggle without price data
checks: Price, currency, period and total clarity

product-catalog.shell: Commerce header with category/search and cart when supported; filter region belongs to results.
regions: Pagination or load-more from the data contract
product-catalog.layout: Consistent media ratios and name/price hierarchy. Derive columns from usable card width. A B2B attribute-comparison task may use a table instead.
product-catalog.responsive: Reduce grid columns without shrinking text excessively; advanced filters open on demand and applied filters remain discoverable.
omit: Quick-buy actions that skip required variant selection
checks: Long product names and missing media
Actual price/stock and working product links

product-detail.intent: Evaluate a product, choose valid options and buy with a clear total.
product-detail.shell: Inherit commerce navigation and cart context.
product-detail.layout: Gallery beside purchase information when width allows. Keep essential purchase conditions visible; supplementary details may be disclosed.
product-detail.responsive: Stack by reading and decision order; sticky purchase controls are optional and must not obscure content/focus.

reading.shell: Editorial: compact header and centered reading column. Documentation: section navigation left and local TOC right only when content warrants them.
regions: Code, media or comparison tables where needed
reading.layout: Constrain reading measure; let code/tables overflow within their own region. A technical docs product can select the technical recipe while retaining this reading pattern.
reading.responsive: Prioritize article width; collapse navigation/TOC into reachable controls; avoid document-wide horizontal scrolling.
omit: Display font for dense control labels

portfolio.intent: Communicate identity through credible selected work.
portfolio.shell: Small top navigation; let project content determine composition.
portfolio.layout: Use editorial project rows or media-led grids; permit distinctive art direction while keeping project identity and navigation readable.
portfolio.responsive: Keep work accessible without hover; reserve media space and preserve project reading order.
omit: Invented clients, awards or impact numbers

focused-task.intent: Complete login, recovery, checkout or a staged task with minimal distractions.
focused-task.shell: Focused shell with identity, back/help when needed and progress only for real stages; avoid carrying a whole workspace menu into the task.
focused-task.layout: Constrain the task width. A checkout summary can be a supporting column; a login form normally needs no second column. Split branding requires real content/assets.
focused-task.responsive: Single readable column; preserve purchase total or progress without obscuring fields.
omit: A stepper for a single-step form
checks: Keyboard and password-manager/native semantics as applicable
